name: slide-to-confirm
summary: A slide-to-pay track whose thumb drags a glowing trail and ticks with haptics.
props: Fires at the end. Return a promise to show a spinner in the thumb; a rejection shakes the track, flashes the danger colour and slides back.
Tinted track with a solid thumb, opt-in two-tone gradient track with a white thumb, transparent track with a tinted hairline, or a 48pt slim track.
Thumb, trail and track colour; only the gradient variant derives a second tone from it.
Auto-reset after this many ms. Otherwise call ref.reset().
Fraction of the track that confirms on release.
Ticks at 25 / 50 / 75 %, success on confirm, error on failure.
Style for the track (merged over its height, radius and colour).
behavior: Drag past the threshold, or flick fast past the halfway point, to confirm; anything less springs back. If onConfirm returns a promise the thumb spins until it settles.
The thumb swells while held and a check draws on success; a rejected promise shakes the track and slides it back.
The idle nudge and the chevron shimmer on the thumb are turned off.
Selection ticks at 25, 50 and 75 percent of the drag, a medium impact on release, then a success or error notification.
A button whose label switches to confirmedLabel when done, with busy and disabled state. The 'activate' action (double tap) confirms without dragging.
